decisions.decision: All nodes have equal functionality; the only difference is discovery.
decisions.rationale: No tier, no class, no lesser node. A browser cannot bind a listening socket, so it cannot be a seed a newcomer dials cold and must be found via a relay — but once connected, peers are indistinguishable, and a browser executes, stores, serves and takes quorum slots identically. Proven cross-device in Phase 3. Any decision keying on node kind is wrong; the only legitimate use is shared-dependency analysis over the discovery graph. Stated by the owner three times because the first two applications changed the vocabulary while leaving the mechanism discriminating.

decisions.decision: A seed contributes no discovery dependency, whatever relays it advertises through.
decisions.rationale: Only a node whose sole discovery path is a relay depends on it. Two certificates with identical relayIds therefore get opposite quorum verdicts. Found by the owner questioning a summary table; the original rule read relayIds without consulting discoverability and refused independent quorums.

decisions.decision: Attestation strength is derived from certificates, never declared by a caller.
decisions.rationale: owner-attested / owner-domain / independent. Owner-domain and independent both show two replicas, so the count alone cannot distinguish them and the label must travel with the result. A caller able to assert 'independently verified' would eventually assert one that was not.

decisions.decision: Disagreement is reported, never voted on.
decisions.rationale: In execution, reduce, and quorum composition alike. At R=2 there is no majority anyway, and voting silently converts 'something is wrong' into 'the majority was right' — the event verification exists to surface.

decisions.decision: Sovereignty is structural, not a preference.
decisions.rationale: planPlacement narrows to the owner's nodes before load is consulted; no branch widens it. A sovereign shard with nowhere to run stalls. Verified by adding the forbidden relax-under-pressure branch and watching four tests fail.

decisions.decision: Derive topology, never agree on it.
decisions.rationale: The reduce tree is a pure function of sorted partial CIDs — zero messages, no leader, no consensus. HRW ranking is itself the fallback list. Repair is recompute from content-addressed inputs, not state transfer; a late duplicate dedupes into nothing.

decisions.decision: The kernel must never require crypto.subtle.
decisions.rationale: A LAN origin is not a secure context. multiformats/hashes/sha2 uses WebCrypto and silently broke every CID on any non-localhost page, while the node still started — so it failed at the first block rather than at join. Now @noble/hashes, pure JS, with a browser test that deletes crypto.subtle.

decisions.decision: Relay browser capacity is capped by inbound limits, not reservations.
decisions.rationale: INBOUND_CONNECTION_THRESHOLD is 5 per HOST and MAX_INCOMING_PENDING_CONNECTIONS is 10, both below the 15 reservation default. Per-host binds in production too: every volunteer behind one NAT shares the budget. Exceeding either kills the noise handshake and reads like a network fault.

next_action: Continue Phase 6 with criterion 1 (discovery by intersecting CID providers with signed capability records) and criterion 2 (power-of-d placement with rejection and re-pick). context_notes: 467 tests green, tsc clean, 42/72 requirements, repository public, Pages deployed by hand with no workflow file. The dominant lesson of this session was that a claim which sounds right is not one that is right: three separate bugs were found by restating a rule plainly and probing it — a fake self-measuring metric, a duty cycle bypassed by concurrency, and a quorum rule that refused independent nodes. Every new checker in this codebase is now falsified with a planted violation before being trusted. The owner corrected the node-equality model three times; the first two attempts changed comments while leaving backbone/edge as classes, so after any design correction, grep for the mechanism rather than the vocabulary.
